An unknown id answers HTTP 200 with an error XML (<Response><result>사용자 정보 검증에 실패하였습니다.</result>), which the expected markers reject as 'not the document'.

scope_questions.question: What is the product's intended use, and who will use it (consumer, professional, custom evaluation kit for R&D)?
scope_questions.rationale: recorded as the regulatory state's intended use and given, as data, to a model that proposes further regulations; no rule reads this free text - the exclusions it hints at are asked as yes/no questions (evaluation_kit, finished_apparatus)

scope_questions.question: Is the product connected to the AC mains (directly, through a fixed cord or a plug)? (yes/no)
scope_questions.rationale: decides AC vs DC for voltage-range rules when the voltage requirement does not say; a contradiction between the two is reported, never resolved

scope_questions.question: What is the highest voltage rating anywhere in the product - input, outputs, internal rails, isolation - e.g. '12 V DC', '230 V AC', '400 V DC'?
scope_questions.rationale: the LVD (Article 1) and the KC tiers rate the equipment by its voltage rating, not by its input alone: a 12 V input feeding a 400 V rail is in scope; the input and output voltage requirements are read too, but only this answer lets a rule say NOT_APPLICABLE

scope_questions.question: Is the product a custom built evaluation kit destined for professionals, to be used solely at research and development facilities? (yes/no)
scope_questions.rationale: Annex II of the LVD and Article 2(2)(e) of the EMC Directive exclude such kits; the quoted exclusion is evaluated from this answer

scope_questions.question: Does the product intentionally transmit or receive radio waves (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, LoRa, cellular, RFID/NFC, any antenna)? (yes/no)
scope_questions.rationale: radio equipment falls under the Radio Equipment Directive / 47 CFR Part 15 Subpart C / 전파법 적합인증 instead of (or in addition to) the general rules

scope_questions.question: Is the product a finished apparatus made available on the market to end-users (no: a custom built evaluation kit or sub-assembly for R&D professionals)? (yes/no)
scope_questions.rationale: the EMC Directive applies to 'apparatus' as defined in Article 3 and excludes custom built evaluation kits (Article 2(2)(e))

scope_questions.question: Does the design contain digital logic, a clock/oscillator or a switching converter (timing signals above 9 kHz)? (yes/no)
scope_questions.rationale: 47 CFR 15.3(k) defines a digital device by pulses above 9,000 per second; 전파법 제58조의2 covers equipment that causes 전자파장해

candidates.title: Directive 2014/35/EU (Low Voltage Directive) - electrical equipment designed for use within certain voltage limits
candidates.authority: European Parliament and Council of the European Union (published on EUR-Lex, Publications Office of the EU)
expected_markers: DIRECTIVE 2014/35/EU OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL
candidates.summary: Safety of electrical equipment with a voltage rating of 50-1000 V AC or 75-1500 V DC (Article 1), except the Annex II equipment (e.g. custom built evaluation kits for R&D professionals). Radio equipment is not subject to it directly: RED Article 3(1)(a) carries its safety objectives with no voltage limit.
candidates.engineering_implication: If applicable: the design must meet the safety objectives of Annex I (protection against electric shock, temperature, mechanical hazards, ...), typically shown through harmonised standards; this needs an engineer and possibly a notified body - not decided here.

applicability_rule.text: applies when the design is not radio equipment (RED Article 1(4)), is not a custom built evaluation kit for R&D professionals (Annex II) and the equipment's voltage rating lies in 50-1000 V AC or 75-1500 V DC (Article 1)

rules.text: radio equipment is covered by Directive 2014/53/EU instead
custom built evaluation kits for R&D professionals are outside the scope (Annex II)
the equipment's voltage rating: the input and output voltage requirements plus the highest rated voltage the user states (highest_rated_voltage); other internal voltages are not read from the IR

candidates.not_evaluated: the Annex II exclusions other than custom built evaluation kits (e.g. equipment for use in an explosive atmosphere, equipment for radiology and medical purposes, electrical parts for lifts, electricity meters, plugs and socket outlets for domestic use, electric fence controllers, specialised equipment for ships, aircraft or railways) are not evaluated

grounding_quotes.quote: This Directive shall apply to electrical equipment designed for use with a voltage rating of between 50 and 1 000 V for alternating current and between 75 and 1 500 V for direct current, other than the equipment and phenomena listed in Annex II.
grounding_quotes.note: the official HTML writes the thousands separator as U+00A0

grounding_quotes.quote: The purpose of this Directive is to ensure that electrical equipment on the market fulfils the requirements providing for a high level of protection of health and safety of persons, and of domestic animals and property, while guaranteeing the functioning of the internal market.
EQUIPMENT AND PHENOMENA OUTSIDE THE SCOPE OF THIS DIRECTIVE
Custom built evaluation kits destined for professionals to be used solely at research and development facilities for such purposes.

candidates.title: Directive 2014/30/EU (EMC Directive) - electromagnetic compatibility
candidates.authority: European Parliament and Council of the European Union (published on EUR-Lex, Publications Office of the EU)
expected_markers: DIRECTIVE 2014/30/EU OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL
candidates.summary: Electromagnetic compatibility of 'equipment' (apparatus or fixed installation): any finished appliance made available on the market as a single functional unit for the end-user that is liable to generate electromagnetic disturbance or be affected by it. Radio equipment is covered by RED Article 3(1)(b) instead; custom built evaluation kits for R&D professionals are excluded (Article 2(2)(e)).
candidates.engineering_implication: If applicable: emissions and immunity per the essential requirements of Annex I, typically shown against harmonised EN standards with test-lab evidence - not decided here.

applicability_rule.text: applies when the design is not radio equipment and is a finished apparatus made available on the market (Article 3(1)(2)), not a custom built evaluation kit (Article 2(2)(e))

rules.text: radio equipment: EMC essential requirements apply through Directive 2014/53/EU Article 3(1)(b)
custom built evaluation kits for R&D professionals are excluded (Article 2(2)(e))

candidates.not_evaluated: the other Article 2(2) exclusions (aeronautical products, radio equipment used by radio amateurs, equipment inherently benign in its electromagnetic effects) and the fixed-installation provisions are not evaluated

grounding_quotes.quote: This Directive regulates the electromagnetic compatibility of equipment. It aims to ensure the functioning of the internal market by requiring equipment to comply with an adequate level of electromagnetic compatibility.
This Directive shall apply to equipment as defined in Article 3.
‘equipment’ means any apparatus or fixed installation;

grounding_quotes.quote: ‘apparatus’ means any finished appliance or combination thereof made available on the market as a single functional unit, intended for the end-user and liable to generate electromagnetic disturbance, or the performance of which is liable to be affected by such disturbance;
custom built evaluation kits destined for professionals to be used solely at research and development facilities for such purposes.

candidates.title: Directive 2011/65/EU (RoHS 2) - restriction of hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment
candidates.authority: European Parliament and Council of the European Union (published on EUR-Lex, Publications Office of the EU)
expected_markers: DIRECTIVE 2011/65/EU OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL
DIRECTIVE 2011/65/EU OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL

candidates.title: Directive 2014/53/EU (Radio Equipment Directive)
candidates.authority: European Parliament and Council of the European Union (published on EUR-Lex, Publications Office of the EU)
expected_markers: DIRECTIVE 2014/53/EU OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL
candidates.summary: Products that intentionally emit and/or receive radio waves for radio communication or radiodetermination (or must be completed with an antenna to do so). In scope, the LVD safety objectives apply with no voltage limit (Article 3(1)(a)) and EMC applies through Article 3(1)(b).
candidates.engineering_implication: If applicable: essential requirements of Article 3 (safety, EMC, efficient use of spectrum, plus delegated acts), conformity assessment with radio test evidence - not decided here.

applicability_rule.text: applies when the product intentionally emits and/or receives radio waves

grounding_quotes.quote: This Directive establishes a regulatory framework for the making available on the market and putting into service in the Union of radio equipment.
Radio equipment falling within the scope of this Directive shall not be subject to Directive 2014/35/EU, except as set out in point (a) of Article 3(1) of this Directive.

‘radio equipment’ means an electrical or electronic product, which intentionally emits and/or receives radio waves for the purpose of radio communication and/or radiodetermination, or an electrical or electronic product which must be completed with an accessory, such as antenna, so as to intentionally emit and/or receive radio waves for the purpose of radio communication and/or radiodetermination;

the protection of health and safety of persons and of domestic animals and the protection of property, including the objectives with respect to safety requirements set out in Directive 2014/35/EU, but with no voltage limit applying;
an adequate level of electromagnetic compatibility as set out in Directive 2014/30/EU.

candidates.title: 전기용품 및 생활용품 안전관리법 (Electrical Appliances and Consumer Products Safety Control Act)
candidates.authority: 산업통상부 국가기술표준원 (KATS); text served by 법제처 국가법령정보센터 open API (law.go.kr)
candidates.summary: Safety management of 전기용품 (industrially produced goods used connected to AC or DC power, and their parts/accessories). Whether a product is 안전인증대상 / 안전확인대상 / 공급자적합성확인대상 is decided by the 시행규칙 (제3조, 별표 3/4/5).
candidates.engineering_implication: If applicable: the product category must be looked up in the 시행규칙 product lists to find the KC tier (안전인증 / 안전확인 / 공급자적합성확인), then the corresponding certification or declaration - not decided here.

applicability_rule.text: the design is a product used connected to AC or DC power (전기용품 definition); the KC tier depends on the product category

grounding_quotes.quote: 이 법은 전기용품 및 생활용품의 안전관리에 관한 사항을 규정함으로써 국민의 생명ㆍ신체 및 재산을 보호하고, 소비자의 이익과 안전을 도모함을 목적으로 한다.
"전기용품"이란 공업적으로 생산된 물품으로서 교류 전원 또는 직류 전원에 연결하여 사용되는 제품이나 그 부분품 또는 부속품을 말한다.
안전인증대상전기용품: 구조 또는 사용 방법 등으로 인하여 화재ㆍ감전 등의 위해가 발생할 우려가 크다고 인정되는 전기용품으로서 안전인증을 통하여 그 위해를 방지할 수 있다고 인정되어 산업통상부령으로 정하는 것
안전인증대상제품의 제조업자(외국에서 제조하여 대한민국으로 수출하는 자를 포함한다. 이하 같다) 또는 수입업자는 안전인증대상제품에 대하여 모델(산업통상부령으로 정하는 고유한 명칭을 붙인 제품의 형식을 말한다. 이하 같다)별로 산업통상부령으로 정하는 바에 따라 안전인증기관의 안전인증을 받아야 한다.

candidates.title: 전파법 (Radio Waves Act) - 제58조의2 방송통신기자재등의 적합성평가 (KC 적합인증 / 적합등록 / 자기적합확인)
candidates.authority: 과학기술정보통신부 / 국립전파연구원 (RRA); text served by 법제처 국가법령정보센터 open API (law.go.kr)
candidates.summary: Anyone manufacturing, selling or importing 방송통신기자재 or equipment that causes or is affected by 전자파장해 must obtain 적합인증 (higher-risk, including radio), 적합등록 or 자기적합확인 (제58조의2). Which tier applies to a product class is set in the 고시 「방송통신기자재등의 적합성평가에 관한 고시」 (not fetched).
candidates.engineering_implication: If applicable: EMC/radio testing at a 지정시험기관 and the KC conformity-assessment procedure for the product's tier - the tier lookup in the 고시 needs an engineer.

applicability_rule.text: applies when the product is radio equipment or contains circuitry that can cause 전자파장해 (digital logic, clocks, switching converters)

grounding_quotes.quote: 방송통신기자재와 전자파장해를 주거나 전자파로부터 영향을 받는 기자재(이하 "방송통신기자재등"이라 한다)를 제조 또는 판매하거나 수입하려는 자는 해당 기자재에 대하여 다음 각 호의 기준(이하 "적합성평가기준"이라 한다)에 따라 제2항에 따른 적합인증, 제3항에 따른 적합등록, 제4항에 따른 자기적합확인 또는 제9항에 따른 잠정인증(이하 "적합성평가"라 한다)을 받아야 한다.
전파환경 및 방송통신망 등에 위해를 줄 우려가 있는 기자재와 중대한 전자파장해를 주거나 전자파로부터 정상적인 동작을 방해받을 정도의 영향을 받는 기자재를 제조 또는 판매하거나 수입하려는 자는 해당 기자재에 대하여 제58조의5에 따른 지정시험기관의 적합성평가기준에 관한 시험을 거쳐 과학기술정보통신부장관의 적합인증을 받아야 한다.
제2항에 따른 적합인증의 대상이 아닌 방송통신기자재등을 제조 또는 판매하거나 수입하려는 자는 제58조의5에 따른 지정시험기관의 적합성평가기준에 관한 시험을 거쳐 해당 기자재가 적합성평가기준에 적합함을 확인한 후 그 사실을 과학기술정보통신부장관에게 등록(이하 "적합등록"이라 한다)하여야 한다.
"전자파장해"란 전자파를 발생시키는 기자재로부터 전자파가 방사(放射: 전자파에너지가 공간으로 퍼져나가는 것을 말한다) 또는 전도[전도: 전자파에너지가 전원선(電源線)을 통하여 흐르는 것을 말한다]되어 다른 기자재의 성능에 장해를 주는 것을 말한다.
"방송통신기자재"란 방송통신설비에 사용하는 장치ㆍ기기ㆍ부품 또는 선조(線條) 등을 말한다.

candidates.title: 47 CFR Part 15 - Radio Frequency Devices (FCC)
candidates.authority: Federal Communications Commission; text published by the Office of the Federal Register (eCFR versioner API)
candidates.summary: Regulations for intentional, unintentional and incidental radiators. Digital logic clocked above 9 kHz makes the product a 'digital device' (unintentional radiator, Subpart B) that must be authorised before marketing through SDoC or certification (§ 15.101) unless exempt (§ 15.103, e.g. power consumption <= 6 nW, or every frequency below 1.705 MHz and no AC-line operation). Transmitters are intentional radiators (Subpart C, certification). The eCFR is not the official legal edition; the GPO annual edition is (see related).
candidates.engineering_implication: If applicable: emissions testing against the Subpart B limits (Class A/B by marketing) or the Subpart C rules for transmitters, then SDoC or certification through subpart J of part 2 - the exemption and tier decisions need an engineer.

applicability_rule.text: applies when the product is an intentional radiator (transmitter) or a digital device (timing signals above 9 kHz)

grounding_quotes.quote: This part sets out the regulations under which an intentional, unintentional, or incidental radiator may be operated without an individual license. It also contains the technical specifications, administrative requirements and other conditions relating to the marketing of part 15 devices.

Digital device. (Previously defined as a computing device). An unintentional radiator (device or system) that generates and uses timing signals or pulses at a rate in excess of 9,000 pulses (cycles) per second and uses digital techniques;

Unintentional radiator. A device that intentionally generates radio frequency energy for use within the device, or that sends radio frequency signals by conduction to associated equipment via connecting wiring, but which is not intended to emit RF energy by radiation or induction.
Intentional radiator. A device that intentionally generates and emits radio frequency energy by radiation or induction.
Class B digital device. A digital device that is marketed for use in a residential environment notwithstanding use in commercial, business and industrial environments.

Except as otherwise exempted in §§ 15.23, 15.103, and 15.113, unintentional radiators shall be authorized prior to the initiation of marketing, pursuant to the procedures for certification or Supplier's Declaration of Conformity (SDoC) given in subpart J of part 2 of this chapter, as follows:
